title: Check time from an SNTP server
summary: Use the sntp command to query a time server and see the current time it reports. This is useful for verifying if your Mac's clock is accurate compared to a standard time source.

steps.explain: Query the specified SNTP server to display the current time it reports.

placeholders.name: SERVER
placeholders.description: The hostname of the SNTP server to query

steps.expect: The command outputs the current time reported by the server.
